data.title: 中野一花 · 夏夜祭典的烟火侧影
data.description: 神社石阶前人潮涌动，绚烂的花火自夜空中轰然绽开。一花手持团扇静静伫立在朱红鸟居旁，漫天火树银花在她的眼眸深处倒映出斑斓色彩。喧嚣的人声仿佛在此刻退去，只留下她唇角那抹若有所思的温柔。
data.action: standing near torii gate, holding fan, looking at fireworks
data.lighting: colorful fireworks bursts illuminating the night
data.promptProse: Standing near a vibrant red shrine torii gate during a summer festival, Nakano Ichika watches brilliant fireworks illuminate the night sky. The colorful ambient bursts highlight her profile and her delicate, nostalgic expression.
data.animaCaption: Ichika watching colorful fireworks near a shrine during festival night.
